entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Mt 14:1-12 . Herod Thinks Jesus a Resurrection of the Murdered Baptist--Account of His Imprisonment and Death. ( = Mr 6:14-29; Lu 9:7-9 ).

entries.heading: 2. And said unto his servants
entries.text: 2. And said unto his servants --his counsellors or court-ministers. This is John the Baptist: he is risen from the dead, &c.--The murdered prophet haunted his guilty breast like a specter and seemed to him alive again and clothed with unearthly powers in the person of Jesus.

entries.heading: Verse 3
entries.text: Account of the Baptist's Imprisonment and Death ( Mt 14:3-12 ). For the exposition of this portion, see on Mr 6:17-29 .

entries.heading: Verse 12
entries.text: Mt 14:12-21 . Hearing of the Baptist's Death, Jesus Crosses the Lake with Twelve, and Miraculously Feeds Five Thousand. ( = Mr 6:30-44; Lu 9:10-17; Joh 6:1-14 ).

entries.heading: Verse 22
entries.text: Mt 14:22-26 . Jesus Crosses to the Western Side of the Lake Walking on the Sea--Incidents on Landing. ( = Mr 6:45; Joh 6:15-24 ).

entries.heading: 28. And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it is thou, bid me come to thee on the water
entries.text: 28. And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it is thou, bid me come to thee on the water --(Also see on Mr 6:50 .)

entries.heading: 29. And he said, Come. And when Peter had come down out of the boat. he walked on the water, to go to Jesus
entries.text: 29. And he said, Come. And when Peter had come down out of the boat. he walked on the water, to go to Jesus --(Also see on Mr 6:50 .)

entries.heading: 30. But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me
entries.text: 30. But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me --(Also see on Mr 6:50 .)

entries.heading: 31. And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said to him, O thou of little faith, why didst thou doubt?
entries.text: 31. And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said to him, O thou of little faith, why didst thou doubt? --(Also see on Mr 6:50 .)
